fusions.name: Swarm Fire
fusions.desc: Fires 3 rounds; each round deals 2 damage.

fusions.name: Carrier's Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 14 damage and has a 60% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gnaw Through
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% chance to crit. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Still Breathing
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
